stdout:
Globulation 2
Command line arguments:
switches:
-c/-C	enable/disable custom cursor
-f/-F	set/clear full screen
-g/-G	enable/disable OpenGL acceleration (GPU use)
-h	full graphics: enable all detail effects
-l	reduced graphics: simplify all detail effects
-m/-M	mute/unmute the sound (both music and speech)
-r/-R	set/clear resizable window
-sgsl	edit SGSL script in the map editor (default)
-usl	edit USL script in the map editor

-d <directory>	add a directory to the directory search list
-dl	print the directory search list
-s <width>x<height>	set initial window size (for instance: -s 800x600
-u <username>	specify a user name
--local-map / --room-map <mapId> <hash> <title> [--instance <origin>]	play a catalog map
--join <invite link or code>	join an online room (also: a glob2:// or https://<instance>/j/<code> link)
--instance <origin>	the instance of an invite code given to --join
-nox <game file name> 	 runs the game without using the X server
-textshot <directory>	 takes pictures of various translation texts as they are drawn on the screen, requires the convert command
-test-games	Creates random games with AI and tests them
-test-games-nox	Creates random games with AI and tests them, without gui
--ai-types <list>	comma-separated AI names to draw from in -test-games* (default: all)
		valid: javascript, numbi, castor, warrush, econo, nicowar, maxima, cortex, cabino
--map <name>	pin the map for -test-games* (resolved as maps/<name>.map)
--matchup <list>	comma-separated per-team AI names; matchup[k] plays team k
		requires --map; mutually exclusive with --ai-types
--save-game-as <path>	write the tick-0 .game file before running -test-games*
		(pair with GLOB2_TEST_SEED for a reproducible scenario)
  --render-game <file.map|file.game> --output file.png [--render-max-pixels 1..8192]
    [--render-field file.field] [--field-color r,g,b]
Map launch modes (put the mode first; no display required):
  --generate-map <generator> [--output file.map] [--preview file.png] [--json report.json]
    [--config file] [--set key=value ...] [--seed N]
    [--width tiles] [--height tiles] [--teams N] [--workers N]
  --preview-map <file.map|file.game> [--output file.png] [--json report.json]
  --export-map-image <file.map|file.game> --output image.png
  --import-map-image <image.png> --output file.map [--preview file.png] [--json report.json]
    [--width tiles] [--height tiles] [--teams N] [--workers N] [--seed N]
    [--image-seam-width 0..16] (default: map short side / 32, clamped 2..12)
  --generate-map <generator> --map-image image.png [other outputs/settings]
  --list-map-generators [generator]  List IDs, or settings and allowed values
Preview scale: --preview-scale 2|4|8 (default 2, relative to retained thumbnail pixels).
Or --preview-size 128..4096 (explicit longest side; cannot combine with scale).
Asset search: -d directory (repeatable).
Supply at least one output: --output, --preview, or --json. Defaults: seed=1, registered settings.
Config: key=value lines; blank lines and # comments allowed. CLI overrides config.
Width/height are tile counts, not exponents. See docs/map-generators/CLI.md.
JSON fields, units and formulas: docs/map-generators/REPORT.md.
-test-map-gen	Generates random maps endlessly, without gui
-vs <name>	record compressed footage to videoshots/<name>.mp4
--record <path.mp4>	record menus, gameplay, and results with automatic chapters
--record-fps <1..240>	output frame rate (default 30)
--record-encoder <auto|software>	encoder selection (default auto)
--record-crf <0..51>	software H.264 quality (default 23)
--record-chapter-ticks <N>	era length (default 10000)
-replay <replay file name>	 replay the game stored in the specified file.
-version	print the version and exit
